gaps.explanation: Statement p6 (GAAP governmental funds statement) Total revenues: General Fund 69,325,756, Streets Fund 12,314,411, Other Governmental Funds 8,229,332 = 89,869,499. Detail: General Fund Budgetary Comparison Schedule p12 Actual Total Revenues 62,684,846 + Streets Fund schedule p13 Actual Total revenues 12,272,259 + nonmajor combining statement columns (pp14-18) 8,229,332 (ties to Other Governmental Funds) = 83,186,437. Gap 6,683,062 = (69,325,756 - 62,684,846 = 6,640,910) + (12,314,411 - 12,272,259 = 42,152). The budgetary schedule's own rows differ from the statement (e.g. Charges for services 12,368,082 vs 13,697,167; Intergovernmental 4,107,225 vs 9,353,351); no fund column is missing and nothing is duplicated. No fix.

Statement p6 Total expenditures: General 54,894,053, Streets 17,469,001, Other Governmental 9,664,038 = 82,027,092. Detail: p12 General budgetary Actual 53,799,987 + p13 Streets 17,697,891 + nonmajor columns 9,664,038 = 81,161,916. Gap 865,176 = (54,894,053 - 53,799,987 = 1,094,066) - (17,697,891 - 17,469,001 = 228,890). Budgetary basis vs GAAP; no fix.

Statement p6 prints transfers gross: General in 5,912,591 / out (12,185,550); Streets in 6,825,550 / out (600,000); Other Governmental in 3,824,936 / out (310,936). The budgetary schedules print only 'Operating transfers, net': General (6,272,959) (p12) = 5,912,591 - 12,185,550; Streets 6,225,550 (p13) = 6,825,550 - 600,000. Detail in = Streets net 6,225,550 + nonmajor gross 3,824,936 = 10,050,486 vs statement 16,563,077. Gap 6,512,591 = General in 5,912,591 + Streets out 600,000, whose money is already inside the two net lines in detail; adding the p6 gross amounts would count it twice. No fix.

Statement p6 Transfers out 13,096,486 (General 12,185,550 + Streets 600,000 + Other 310,936). Detail out = General net (6,272,959) (p12) + nonmajor (310,936) = 6,583,895. Gap 6,512,591 = 12,185,550 + 600,000 - 6,272,959, the mirror of the transfers_in gap (netted in the budgetary schedules). No fix.

Statement p6 'Subscription proceeds': General Fund 61,788, Other Governmental Funds 15,860, Total 77,648 = JSON debt_proceeds; 'Proceeds from sales of capital asset' General Fund 24,946 = JSON other_financing. The 15,860 is in detail (Enhanced 911 Fund, nonmajor combining p14). The General Fund budgetary schedule p12 prints no subscription proceeds, so the 61,788 is in no detail line: added in the General Fund from p6. After the add, debt-proceeds detail = 61,788 + 15,860 = 77,648 = debt_proceeds. The other non-transfer other-financing detail line is p12 'Proceeds from sales of capital assets' 77,188 (budgetary basis), the same row as p6's 24,946 (GAAP): non-transfer OF detail 77,648 + 77,188 = 154,836 vs debt_proceeds + other_financing 77,648 + 24,946 = 102,594; difference 52,242 = 77,188 - 24,946 is the budgetary vs GAAP basis of the sale-of-assets row. Adding the p6 24,946 would count that row twice, so it is not added.
